integrity: The proof independently derives a three-unit lower bound on each clique layer for any candidate of total weight at most six. At equality, the only possible layer profile is a single label 3; the quasi-total isolated-positive rule then forces the two labels 3 to occupy a matching edge. The bundled definition-level checker exhausts all labelings for n=3,4,5 and separately checks the claimed family through n=50.
scientific_limitations: The optimizer classification is for complete prisms K_n square K_2 with n at least four.
For n=3 the value is still six but additional optimal label patterns occur; n=2 is the previously solved cycle C_4.
No claim is made for ordinary prism graphs C_n square K_2 or general Cartesian products.
Finite exhaustive verification covers n=3,4,5 and is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed exact treatment of the same family may exist.
title: Quasi-total double Roman domination of complete prisms
